title: Trophy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#FFC300'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#E09A00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldDark' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#E09A00'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#B87400'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handles -->
  <path d='M22 26 C 8 26, 8 50, 24 52' fill='none' stroke='#FFC300' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 26 C 92 26, 92 50, 76 52' fill='none' stroke='#FFC300' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cup -->
  <path d='M24 20 L76 20 C 76 44, 66 58, 50 60 C 34 58, 24 44, 24 20 Z' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <!-- cup shine -->
  <path d='M33 24 C 33 38, 38 50, 46 55' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='20' y='15' width='60' height='9' rx='4' fill='url(#goldDark)'/>
  <rect x='24' y='16' width='52' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>

  <rect x='44' y='59' width='12' height='9' fill='url(#goldDark)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='60' width='3' height='7' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- base -->
  <path d='M32 68 L68 68 L72 78 L28 78 Z' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='26' y='78' width='48' height='9' rx='3' fill='url(#goldDark)'/>
  <rect x='30' y='79' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- star on cup -->
  <path d='M50 30 L53 38 L61 38 L55 43 L57 51 L50 46 L43 51 L45 43 L39 38 L47 38 Z' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
</svg>
